source.title: Kafra - Gale Rider
source.name: Kafra
source.description: A determined Warrior who doesn't hesitate to charge at enemies in front.

skills.name: Gale Thrust

description.raw: Passive. Kafra prioritizes attacking the enemy who carries Forest Mark. Kafra inflicts a Forest Mark on an enemy when casting Ultimate and launches a mighty strike, dealing 500% (ATK-based) + 50% (SP-based) damage and knocking them back for 2-tile. Only 1 Forest Mark exists per attack.
passive: Kafra prioritizes attacking the enemy who carries Forest Mark.
Kafra inflicts a Forest Mark on an enemy when casting Ultimate and launches a mighty strike, dealing 500% (ATK-based) + 50% (SP-based) damage and knocking them back for 2-tile.
Only 1 Forest Mark exists per attack.

skills.description_lite: Kafra knocks back an enemy and inflicts a Forest Mark on them.

skills.name: Relentless Chase

description.raw: When a marked enemy is out of Kafra's attack range, Kafra charges towards the enemy, dealing 280% (ATK-based) damage and stunning them for 1.5 + 0.5 (SP-based)s. If there's no marked enemy, Kafra marks the nearest enemy and casts the skill.
active: When a marked enemy is out of Kafra's attack range, Kafra charges towards the enemy, dealing 280% (ATK-based) damage and stunning them for 1.5 + 0.5 (SP-based)s.
If there's no marked enemy, Kafra marks the nearest enemy and casts the skill.

skills.description_lite: Kafra charges towards the marked enemy, dealing damage and stunning them.

skills.name: Forest's Wrath

description.raw: The Forest Mark reduces the enemy's Phys DEF by 6%. When a marked enemy is defeated, Kafra and allies within 2 tiles of this enemy recover 100% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) HP every 0.375s for 1.125s.
active: The Forest Mark reduces the enemy's Phys DEF by 6%.
When a marked enemy is defeated, Kafra and allies within 2 tiles of this enemy recover 100% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) HP every 0.375s for 1.125s.

skills.description_lite: Kafra reduces the marked enemies' Phys DEF. He also gains buffs when the marked enemy is defeated.

skills.name: Sylvan Banishment

description.raw: When a marked enemy receives healing from other enemies, Kafra jumps to the healer and attacks them, dealing 250% (ATK-based) damage and reducing their Haste by 40 for 5s. Kafra is unaffected during the period.
active: When a marked enemy receives healing from other enemies, Kafra jumps to the healer and attacks them, dealing 250% (ATK-based) damage and reducing their Haste by 40 for 5s.
Kafra is unaffected during the period.

text: Kafra gains a shield that can block 350% (ATK-based) damage for 5s while casting this skill.

skills.description_lite: Kafra attacks the enemy who heals the marked enemy.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: The damage of Relentless Chase's first casting in battle is increased to 520% (ATK-based).
active: The damage of Relentless Chase's first casting in battle is increased to 520% (ATK-based).

skills.description_lite: The damage of Relentless Chase's first casting is increased.
